name_ascii: PNW-MAE Pacific Northwest and Mid-Atlantic Express
vehicle_note: 6-gleisig (2x Express, 2x Regional, 2x Güter-Transit), ETCS Level 3 Moving Block, Halbstundentakt 24/7. Schwere 1.200m-Fracht-Maglevs nutzen separate periphere Terminals außerhalb der Passagierbahnhöfe.
infra_note: 6.100 km, 11 Std. 46 Min., 13 Zwischenhalte plus zahlreiche Non-Stop-Bypass-Durchfahrten (Bellingham-North, Everett-East, Tacoma-Dome Bypass, Olympia-South Ring, Bend-East, Burns-Basin, Ely-West, Amarillo-East, Sayre-Plains, Shawnee-Loop, Fort Smith River-Viaduct, Little Rock-North Ring, Jackson-South Bypass, Knoxville-West Gate, Greensboro-East Loop, Petersburg-South Bypass, Williamsburg-East, Toms River-Bypass, Edison-Metropark Transit). Zeiten lokal (PT/MT/CT/ET). Größte Tunnel: Mount Hood (42 km), Black Canyon/Lake Mead (18 km), Great Smoky Mountains (78 km), Chesapeake Bay (34 km), Delaware Bay (22 km), Hudson River. Teilt Surrey/Seattle-Tukwila/Portland-Salmon Creek/Las Vegas-South/Albuquerque-West mit NHA und NYC Penn Deep mit NCAMS/NHA.
